newsitem.title: USA: Former AMA head to join tobacco talks - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Former AMA head to join tobacco talks - WSJ.

text.p: Officials from leading public health groups have chosen Lonnie Bristow, the former president of the American Medical Association, to join the tobacco industry's settlement talks, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
The Journal said the move could give more legitimacy to the antitobacco negotiating team, the newspaper said.
Bristow was not immediately available for comment, the paper said.
